upstream_nitro.backlog_scope: Unconfirmed sequencer feed only; no L2 state, receipts, canonical history completeness or execution proof

prior_ethereum_peer_backend.scope: Maintained Ethereum consensus ReqResp; Fulu column acquisition/reconstruction is not implemented by this raw store

b3_raw_object_exchange.scope: Explicitly B3-specific untrusted content availability; native verification remains mandatory

external_requirements: Live raw witness producer or maintained local Nitro replay; no qualified public sparse raw-witness archive established
Reviewed deployed rollup/proxy/storage policy, ETH authority and native operator handoff remain independently gated
An authenticated starting state and complete L1 batch/delayed-inbox availability are required for Nitro execution replay
Historical Fulu data columns require maintained recovery and KZG verification; old blob-sidecar requests are insufficient
A self-hosted EL+CL+Nitro archive is one resource-heavy option, not a universal lower bound for future proof services
